annotations.title: Say what you are working on

description: Report what you are working on (areas: file paths, modules, topics). Call when you start on something so teammates' agents see it and conflicts surface early.

areas.description: areas name what is being worked on: file paths, modules, topics.

note.description: note is an optional short description of what you are doing now.

producer.description: producer names this instance; defaults to the user's name.

space.description:
space optionally selects which of your spaces to act in (an id or name
 from list_spaces). Omit it when you belong to a single space.

name: report_activity
title: Say what you are working on
